purpose: One bounded end-to-end acceptance through the normal production UI; no capacity claim.
preconditions_before_the_single_start: A dated current provider-balance record exists.
A binding monetary cap for this one job is documented in currency and amount.
Sebastian has explicitly authorized this exact paid run after seeing the cap.
The processing pause is changed only within that authorization and without changing model or review quality.
The normal production login, access approval and current consent checks all pass.
No queued or running case-analysis job exists for the test owner.
pass_rule: Pass only when every required evidence item and all eight locked content criteria pass. A simulation, server-only run, generated blob without browser download, or missing saved result is not a pass.
stop_and_fail_conditions: A second job is created or attempted.
The job ends failed, cancelled, expired, quota-limited or review-unresolved.
The saved roadmap is absent, stale or cannot be reopened through normal access.
Any original, amount, source attribution, open question, Word file, PDF file or Android step fails its check.
The documented monetary cap or authorized scope would be exceeded.
